source_name: BQK — Korniza Ligjore (Legal Framework hub: Ligjet / Rregulloret / Rregullat / Udhëzimet / Urdhëresat / Arkiva)
why_relevant: Root hub of the only legally mandated issuer of binding banking rules in Kosovo. Search-result snippets show it carries the full taxonomy of binding instruments (laws, regulations, rules, instructions, orders, archive) and is the canonical entry point for every A3 rule-tracking task.

source_name: BQK — Arkiva e rregullave (repealed / superseded regulations archive)
why_relevant: Lets you diff current vs. superseded rulebook versions and reconstruct the timeline of regulatory change — essential for detecting what changed and when a new regime replaced an old one.

source_name: BQK — Vendimet e Bordit të BQK-së (CBK Board decisions index)
why_relevant: The Board is the body that formally APPROVES regulations; these per-meeting posts are the earliest public signal that a specific regulation was adopted (often before the PDF is posted). Directly yields adoption dates that anchor effective-date/compliance-deadline tracking.

source_name: CBK — Odluke Odbora (Board decisions, Serbian-language mirror)
why_relevant: Serbian-language rendering of the same board-decision stream; useful as a cross-check when the Albanian page is truncated and mandatory for sr-language coverage of the cell.

source_name: BQK — Lajme dhe Ngjarje / News and Events (announcement stream)
why_relevant: Where BQK self-announces new/amended regulations, entry-into-force dates, consultation openings and supervisory measures. Highest-frequency early-warning feed for the cell.

source_name: BQK — Udhëzimet dhe Procedurat (guidelines and procedures, legacy CMS index id=121)
why_relevant: Guidelines (udhëzime) are described by BQK as generally applicable, binding in their entirety and directly applicable — i.e. soft-law that carries hard obligations and deadlines. Legacy numeric-id CMS index still surfaces items not always visible in the new nav.

source_name: BQK — /wp-content/uploads/ document repository (current regulation PDFs)
why_relevant: The actual binding texts live here as dated PDFs (YYYY/MM path segments), which makes publication month machine-readable and enables change detection independent of the HTML nav. Observed items: corporate governance of banks, IT for banks, information systems (Board-approved 29 Aug 2025), macroprudential capital buffers, bank account registry, advertising of financial services.

source_name: BQK — legacy /repository/docs/korniza_ligjore/ (older regulation texts, sq/sr/en subfolders)
why_relevant: Pre-migration document store still serving live regulation PDFs (credit registry, bank account registry, residential mortgage loans, international payments). Language is encoded in the path (shqip/…), so the same tree is the route to sr/en texts.

source_name: BQK — Mbikëqyrja Makroprudenciale (macroprudential supervision: framework docs + Executive Board macroprudential measures)
why_relevant: Page explicitly hosts regulatory/strategic documents and Executive Board decisions on macroprudential measures — i.e. binding buffer settings (CCyB, systemic buffers) with activation dates and phase-in deadlines that banks must meet.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i mbikëqyrjes së bazuar në rrezik për banka (risk-based supervision manual)
why_relevant: Discloses how BQK actually supervises: examination cycle, risk-rating methodology, escalation. Predicts what supervisors will demand of banks and vendors ahead of any formal rule change.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i Licencimit Bankar / Banking Licensing Manual (Department of Licensing and Standardization)
why_relevant: Authoritative statement of licensing rules: mandatory pre-application meeting, fit-and-proper criteria for directors/senior managers, EUR 7m equivalent capital deposit (DEK) for foreign bank branches. Licensing rules are an explicit topic of this cell and change with each rulebook revision.

source_name: BQK — Mbikëqyrja Financiare section (supervision department landing + reporting requirements)
why_relevant: Parent section for the banking supervision track: licensing, reporting forms and instructions that all CBK-licensed institutions must submit to the Department for Banking Supervision. Reporting-form revisions are de-facto compliance deadlines.

source_name: BQK — Rregulloret e UNMIK-ut (UNMIK-era regulations, historical legal base)
why_relevant: Historical legal layer under the current rulebook; occasionally still cited as the origin of supervisory powers. Low frequency but needed for full legal-lineage reconstruction.

source_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës (GZK) — official gazette, banking & central-bank laws
why_relevant: Legally authoritative publication venue for the primary laws that empower BQK's rulemaking (Law 03/L-209 on the CBK; Law 04/L-093 on Banks, MFIs and NBFIs; Law 08/L-304 on Banks; Law 08/L-295 on Crypto-Assets). Gazette publication date is the definitive trigger for entry-into-force arithmetic. Multilingual (sq/sr/en) by statute.

source_name: BQK-hosted consolidated law texts (sq/sr) — Ligji Nr. 08/L-304 për Bankat / Zakon br. 08/L-304 o bankama
why_relevant: New banking law (gazetted as Official Gazette No. 2, 27 January 2026 per the Serbian version's header) — the enabling act that will force a wave of BQK secondary regulation and transition deadlines during the tracking window. BQK hosts both language versions.

source_name: Platforma e Konsultimeve Publike (konsultimet.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: Kosovo's statutory public-consultation platform (Regulation No. 05/2016 on minimum standards for public consultation, run by the Office for Good Governance/OPM). Trilingual sq/sr/en. It is the place where draft acts affecting banking — and any BQK-related draft routed through government — are exposed with comment windows and closing dates. No BQK-issued consultation was confirmed here in this pass, so treat as a monitored channel, not an established BQK feed.

source_name: BQK Strategic Roadmap on Climate & Environmental Risk Management (example of a BQK document explicitly released for public consultation)
why_relevant: Concrete evidence that BQK does run public consultation on supervisory documents and records the consultation history inside the document itself. Establishes the document-internal consultation trail as an extraction target when no separate consultation page exists.

source_name: Office of the Prime Minister — Concept Document on Developing the Regulatory Framework for Financial Markets
why_relevant: Concept documents (koncept-dokument) are the mandated pre-legislative step in Kosovo; this one signals the direction of future financial-market legislation and therefore of BQK's future rulemaking and supervisory perimeter — a forward indicator ahead of any draft regulation.

source_name: Vokshi & Lata Law Firm — Kosovo financial-regulation client alerts (e.g. crypto-asset licensing deadlines)
why_relevant: Local counsel alerts translate BQK/Assembly instruments into concrete compliance deadlines ('what businesses must prepare by December') faster and more explicitly than the regulator does. Useful as a deadline cross-check and as a pointer to instruments you may have missed.

source_name: BQK official YouTube channel (@bqkofficial)
why_relevant: Governor/Board press conferences and roundtables often state rationale, timing and expected effective dates for new regulations before the written instrument is posted; also reveals which stakeholders were consulted.

source_name: BQK — Edukimi Financiar FAQ (bqk-kos.org/edu) as a plain-language pointer to licensing/regulatory procedure
why_relevant: States operational procedure in plain Albanian (which department to contact, mandatory informative meeting before licence application, contact details), which helps map internal BQK actors — Departamenti i Licencimit dhe Standardizimit, Departamenti për Mbikëqyrjen Bankare — for the actor map.

source_name: IMF Financial Sector Stability Review for Kosovo (hosted on BQK site, sq/sr/en)
why_relevant: External assessment of the Kosovo supervisory regime with explicit recommendations; BQK regulatory agendas frequently follow FSSR recommendations, so it is a leading indicator of which rules will be drafted next.

source_name: BQK — ?lang= language-variant mechanism (sq default, ?lang=en, ?lang=sr) across all pages and PDFs
why_relevant: Structural finding rather than a document: the entire BQK site (including uploaded PDFs, e.g. '...pdf?lang=sr') is addressable in three languages via a query parameter, and Serbian path slugs differ from Albanian ones (o-cbk vs rreth-bqk, finansijska-stabilnost vs stabiliteti-financiar). Any collector must enumerate both slug families or it will silently miss sr-only renderings.

source_name: env2.bqk-kos.org — BQK staging/secondary environment
why_relevant: A second indexed host serving BQK content. Potentially a staging environment where restructured pages appear before the production site, and a fallback route if production WAF blocks a collector. Handle with care: content may be non-authoritative.

source_name: BQK / CBK — Korniza ligjore: Rregulloret (Regulations index)
why_relevant: Canonical index of all CBK regulations, including the payment-systems series (B-series) covering PI/EMI authorisation, IBAN, electronic payment instruments, non-bank PSP access to payment systems. This is the primary publication channel for payments rulemaking, distinct from prudential supervision circulars.

source_name: BQK — Regulation on the Authorization and Governance of Payment Institutions and E-Money Institutions and Registration of AISP (B15)
why_relevant: Core licensing rule for payment institutions, e-money institutions and account information service providers — the gating document for any new payments market entrant in Kosovo. Approved by the CBK Board in mid-2026, i.e. the current PSD2-aligned regime.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave (non-bank PSP access to payment systems)
why_relevant: Sets the conditions under which non-bank PSPs/EMIs can access KIPS and interconnected systems — the key structural rule for fintech participation in clearing, and a SEPA-alignment requirement (settlement finality / access).
